notes: Windows v2.5.0 restores Stereomasken-inspired alignment grids and three-band outline frames. Grids have per-axis line counts, colors and opacity and never enter exports. Outline bands follow each eye's frame/disparity, respect foreground protrusions, and support independent widths/colors, editor visibility, Undo and project saving. Includes all v2.4.1 version-consistency and toolbox improvements.
